jev.coop: Coop keeps the gas station in Chunky, Mississippi. On his walk tonight, along US 80 to the river bridge and back, he's thinking over something to do with a neighbor who's been coming by.
trips: The neighbor's never been out with him.
The neighbor's been out with him once.
The neighbor's been out with him {n} times.
jev.done: The last time he asked, the neighbor came.
jev.missed: The last time he asked, the neighbor said yes and never came.
jev.lapsed: The last time he asked, the neighbor never came.

lines.ask: Found a hole on my walk last night: {place}. Catfish rolling like hogs. I'm going back at nine. You coming?
lines.yes: Nine. Don't bring nothing. I got a spare.
lines.no: Offer's good three nights. After that the fish forget me.
lines.came: You came. Spare rod, and worms.
lines.done: That's me. Keep the rod. It never caught me nothing.
lines.lapse: Guess you got busy. Fish don't wait.

notes.missed: Said yes to fishing at {place}, then never showed.
